prefs.appearanceHelp: Choose the mode and the palette you prefer.

pin.title: PIN
pin.intro: The PIN you enter the till with. Change it whenever you want — nobody else has to.
pin.introNone: You do not have a PIN yet. Set one to also enter from the till.
pin.mismatch: The two PINs do not match.

device.title: This device
device.intro: How this device asks who is using it. Each device of the business is decided on its own.
device.shared: Shared — a till or tablet several people use
device.sharedHelp: It asks for a PIN to enter and forgets it at the end of the shift, so every sale is in the name of whoever made it.
device.personal: Personal — a device only you use
device.personalHelp: The session stays open and it never asks for a PIN.
device.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change how people enter on this device.
device.unknown: This browser is not a device of the business yet: enter once here with your account and you will be able to choose.
device.failed: Could not change this device. Check the connection and try again.
device.loadError: Could not load this device. Check the connection and try again.

pinPolicy.title: PIN pad
pinPolicy.showHelp: Whether the PIN pad is shown and who is at the till is asked. It holds for the whole business: besides, each device decides on its own, above.
pinPolicy.on: Staff choose their name and type their PIN, so every sale carries the name of whoever made it.
pinPolicy.off: Nobody types a PIN. Whoever opened the till in the morning is the name of every sale until the shift ends, whoever made them: you will not know who sold what or who gave a discount. Staff who only have a PIN and no account will not be able to enter.
pinPolicy.againMinutes: A till nobody touches for {n} minutes closes the session and shows the PIN pad: the next sale carries the name of the next person.
pinPolicy.againShift: The PIN pad asks again when the session ends: at the end of the shift or when someone signs out.
pinPolicy.digitsHelp: Everyone types the same number of digits, which is what lets the keypad enter at the last one instead of asking you to confirm. The PINs in use keep working until their owner changes them.
pinPolicy.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change whether it asks.
pinPolicy.failed: Could not change it. Check the connection and try again.
pinPolicy.loadError: Could not load how the business asks for the PIN. Check the connection and try again.

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: The devices someone has entered on. If you lose one, remove it here: its session closes at once and it can no longer enter with a PIN.
devices.renamePlaceholder: Name the place: Bar, Kitchen, Office laptop
devices.renameFailed: Could not change the name. Check the connection and try again.
devices.removeBody: Its session closes at once. To use it again, someone has to enter on it with their account.
devices.removeYours: It is the device you are using: removing it will close your session and you will have to enter again.
devices.removeFailed: Could not remove this device. Check the connection and try again.
devices.pruneOne: Remove the device unused for 30 days
devices.pruneMany: Remove the {n} devices unused for 30 days
devices.pruneAsk: Remove {n} devices nobody has used for 30 days?
devices.pruneBody: They stop showing here and, to use one again, someone will have to enter on it with their account. Those used in the last 30 days and the one you are using stay.
devices.pruneFailed: Could not remove the unused devices. Check the connection and try again.
devices.empty: Nobody has entered from any device yet.
devices.adminOnly: Only an administrator can see and remove the devices.
devices.loadError: Could not load the devices. Check the connection and try again.
